before.text: A third way that stress can come up is through our THOUGHTS. Stress can change how you think.
Your mind might feel foggy or confused.
Things you know might suddenly become hard to remember.
Or, you might imagine something bad will happen if you try, which makes you want to give up before you even start.
But remember, this is just thought stress. It can feel big and scary, but we are strong and we can absolutely overcome it.
Even the mightiest forest creatures feel stress feelings. If we know how to spot them, then we can choose to focus on more helpful thoughts instead.
